message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School before being selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers.

He has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (2003–2010; 2014–2018), Miami Heat (2010–2014), and Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present). LeBron has won four NBA championships—two with Miami (2012, 2013), one with Cleveland (2016), and one with Los Angeles (2020)—and earned four NBA Most Valuable Player awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013). He has been named to the All‑NBA First Team 13 times and has been selected for the NBA All‑Star Game 19 times, setting a record for most selections.

Beyond his on‑court achievements, LeBron is known for his philanthropy, notably the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the “I Promise” school in Akron to support at-risk youth. He’s also a prominent media personality, producing and starring in films such as *Space Jam: A New Legacy* and the documentary series *The Last Dance*, and he has launched his own production company, SpringHill Entertainment.
